A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DiBO research and contain 21 readable pages, including Appendices A-D. Text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic and real-world optimization experiments, component ablations, sensitivity analyses, and runtime measurements in Sections 4-5 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3, Algorithm 1, and Appendix B retain identical training objectives, posterior sampling, local search, filtering, and dataset updates. Replacing 'an ensemble of proxies' with 'deep ensembles' in the abstract is a terminology edit.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Rastrigin, Ackley, Levy, and Rosenbrock at 200 and 400 dimensions, plus HalfCheetah-102D, RoverPlanning-100D, and DNA-180D. Revised application examples in the introduction do not change evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Figures 3-4 and Table 5 retain TuRBO, LA-MCTS, MCMC-BO, CMA-BO, CMA-ES, CbAS, MINs, DDOM, and Diff-BBO. Appendix D.6 also retains the same MC-dropout and single-proxy comparisons. Newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Sections 4.2-4.3 and Appendices A-D retain identical initialization sizes, batch sizes, evaluation budgets, search spaces, training settings, and testing procedures. The 6,000-evaluation exception for MCMC-BO on 400-dimensional tasks is also unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D retain all component ablations and sensitivity analyses, including reweighting, sampling, training epochs, off-policy training, uncertainty estimation, buffer sizes, and additional computation. No analysis is added, removed, or revised.

E5.justification: Figure 3 still reports four seeds, Figure 4 ten seeds, and the appendix experimental figures four seeds, with means and one standard deviation. Uncertainty reporting and runtime-table error values are unchanged.

E6.justification: All experimental plots, runtime entries, and reported findings are identical. For example, both versions already report Ackley-200D scores of -0.643 under the default configuration and -0.260 with J=50 and L=2000 in Appendix D.8.

T1.justification: Equations 1-23 are unchanged, including the KL-regularized target distribution, relative trajectory balance objective, and PF-ODE likelihood derivation in Appendix B.2.2. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Both claim sample-efficient high-dimensional optimization through diffusion-based posterior inference and superior performance against baselines on synthetic and real-world tasks. The abstract's shortened wording preserves these claims, and the contribution statements and conclusion are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of exploration, exploitation, ablation outcomes, and computational tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 7 retains the limitation of retraining diffusion models each round, and Appendix D retains the same qualifications and future directions.

D1.justification: Appendices A-C retain identical task implementations, architectures, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and baseline details. The code and resource-link targets are unchanged; the added correspondence and funding information supplies no new reproducibility details.

R1.justification: The introduction replaces Brochu/Shahriari BO references with Kushner/Garnett, adds latent-space references including Gómez-Bombarelli and Maus, and substitutes Tripp et al. (2020) for its Krishnamoorthy et al. (2023) reweighting citation. Application citations and bibliography membership also change, but Section 6 and the substantive novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 lightly edits the abstract and introductory application examples, adds a funding acknowledgement and another correspondence contact, and replaces the preprint notice with ICML publication information. The main narrative and appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: The first page reflows around revised text and publication information; acknowledgements and bibliography edits shift content on pages 9-11. Figures 1-12, Tables 1-5, and Algorithm 1 retain their displays and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 adjusts introductory citations and wording and adds publication and funding information, while Sections 3-7 and Appendices A-D remain unchanged. These localized refinements do not materially change the paper's explanatory clarity, empirical support, reproducibility, or treatment of limitations.
